integrity: All analytic claims are proved from explicit source coefficients and polynomial identities; accompanying exact algebra checks are supporting evidence, not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the exact two-period step mesh, the source three-step coefficient prescription, exact arithmetic, and the specified scalar test equations are addressed. Pole-free does not imply A-stable; arbitrary adaptive step sequences and floating-point behavior are not classified.
title: Two sharp thresholds for alternating-grid BDFL3: periodic zero-stability versus stiff-stage solvability
